en.summary: This commit fixes AXI read-response tagging by appending the bank-local selected source port to each read ID instead of concatenating the whole selector vector.
why_it_counts: It corrects active RTL in the multi-input AXI adapter response path.
The bug directly affects which upstream requester receives returned read data.
The fix is precise and has a clean reusable mutation pattern.
evidence: Inside the NUM_PORTS_IN > 1 branch, xbar_tag_r_out changes from {xbar_tag_out, req_xbar_sel_out} to {xbar_tag_out, req_xbar_sel_out[i]}.
That tag is assigned to m_axi_arid and later used to route AXI read responses back through the response crossbar.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a shared read adapter issues requests from multiple upstream ports to multiple downstream banks, each read ID must carry the originating requester encoded for the specific bank that accepted the transaction. If the logic accidentally concatenates a wider selector structure instead of the bank-local selected source, the return ID no longer names the right requester and read data can be delivered to the wrong client.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A multi-input adapter issues read requests and later routes responses back by decoding requester identity from the returned read ID.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Assemble the read ID from the wrong selector scope so the requester field is not the bank-local selected input.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: use global selector vector in per-bank tag assembly
portability_notes: This mutation only matters when more than one upstream requester shares the adapter.
The bug belongs in the request-ID generation path, not in the downstream response decoder.
A crossbar, arbiter, or banked memory adapter that appends requester ID bits is a good injection target.
concrete_injection_steps: Find where the adapter builds a downstream read ID from an internal transaction tag plus requester identity.
Locate the per-bank or per-output selected requester field.
Replace that bank-local selection with a wider selector vector or other mismatched source-identity signal.
Keep the response decode logic unchanged so it trusts the corrupted ID bits on the return path.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_axi_adapter read ID generation in g_xbar_tag_r_out
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes xbar_tag_r_out so each bank appends req_xbar_sel_out[i] rather than the whole req_xbar_sel_out array when forming m_axi_arid.
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: restore wrong selector source in read tag
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In hw/rtl/libs/VX_axi_adapter.sv, revert xbar_tag_r_out to use req_xbar_sel_out without indexing by bank.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Read responses return with the wrong requester ID bits and are delivered to the wrong upstream port or dropped by the return-routing logic.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change is the selector used when forming xbar_tag_r_out.
m_axi_arid is directly driven from that assembled tag.
The bug is guarded by NUM_PORTS_IN > 1, matching a multi-requester routing failure.
notes: This is only observable in multi-input configurations.
A stress test with concurrent reads from different requesters is the most direct way to expose it.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 AXI 读响应 tag 组装：每个读 ID 应拼接该 bank 本地选中的源端口，而不是把整个选择向量都拼进去。
why_it_counts: 它修正了多输入 AXI 适配器响应路径中的实际 RTL。
该错误会直接影响返回读数据被送往哪个上游请求者。
修复点非常精确，且具有清晰的可复用反向注入模式。
evidence: 在 NUM_PORTS_IN > 1 分支内，xbar_tag_r_out 从 {xbar_tag_out, req_xbar_sel_out} 改成了 {xbar_tag_out, req_xbar_sel_out[i]}。
这个 tag 会被赋给 m_axi_arid，并在后续通过响应 crossbar 把 AXI 读响应路由回上游。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一个共享读适配器把多个上游端口的请求发往多个下游 bank 时，每个读 ID 都必须携带“真正发起该请求的上游请求者”信息，而且这个信息必须是针对接受该请求的那个 bank 本地编码的。如果逻辑错误地拼接了更宽的选择结构，而不是该 bank 本地选中的源请求者，返回 ID 就不再指向正确的请求者，读数据可能被送到错误客户端。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多输入适配器发起读请求，并通过返回的读 ID 解码请求者身份来路由响应时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 用错误层级的选择信号组装读 ID，使请求者字段不再表示该 bank 本地选中的输入。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在按 bank 的 tag 组装中使用全局选择向量
portability_notes: 只有多个上游请求者共享同一个适配器时，这个故障才有意义。
故障点位于请求 ID 生成路径，而不是下游响应解码器。
任何会把请求者 ID 追加进 tag 的 crossbar、仲裁器或分 bank 适配器都适合注入该类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到适配器用内部事务 tag 加上请求者身份来生成下游读 ID 的逻辑。
定位按 bank 或按输出选出的那个请求者字段。
把这个本地选中信号替换成更宽的选择向量，或其他不匹配的来源身份信号。
保持响应解码逻辑不变，让它继续信任返回路径上被破坏的 ID 比特。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_axi_adapter 中 g_xbar_tag_r_out 的读 ID 生成
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 xbar_tag_r_out 改为在形成 m_axi_arid 时，按 bank 追加 req_xbar_sel_out[i]，而不是整个 req_xbar_sel_out 数组。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 恢复错误的选择源来生成读 tag
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 hw/rtl/libs/VX_axi_adapter.sv 中，把 xbar_tag_r_out 改回使用未按 bank 索引的 req_xbar_sel_out。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 读响应会带着错误的请求者 ID 比特返回，被路由到错误的上游端口，或者在返回路由中被丢弃。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交唯一的功能改动就是组装 xbar_tag_r_out 时所用的选择信号。
m_axi_arid 直接由这个组装后的 tag 驱动。
该错误只在 NUM_PORTS_IN > 1 时出现，和多请求者路由失效完全一致。
notes: 该故障只会在多输入配置中显现。
最直接的复现方式是让不同请求者并发发起读访问。
